caption: The drawing features a single ornate object centered on a plain, light background. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, showing strong contrast and shading. It consists of an elaborate floral or foliate motif, with a central rounded element resembling a rose or a bud, flanked by large, outward-curving symmetrical leaves. Above the central element are three upward-pointing, leaf-like projections, also detailed with shading to suggest depth and curl. The entire form appears to be resting on a flat, horizontal base or plinth. The drawing is executed in a realistic, detailed style, with careful attention to the texture and curvature of each segment. There is minimal surrounding detail, and the object is prominently displayed in the center of the composition.
title: Fragment of Fence
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
